python -c "
import toolz

# trace through Compose([inc, double])(3)
inc = lambda x: x + 1
double = lambda x: x * 2

print('trace:')
print(f'inc(3) = {inc(3)}')
print(f'double(3) = {double(3)}')
print(f'double(inc(3)) = {double(inc(3))}')
print(f'inc(double(3)) = {inc(double(3))}')

# So Compose([inc, double]) does inc(double(3)) = 7, which is right-to-left
# That's consistent with standard compose behavior (right-to-left)
"
